title: Rules.
bodyText: Rules prescribing procedures effectuating the purpose of this chapter shall be adopted by the department in consultation with the department of taxation pursuant to chapter 91.
bodyHtml: §209E-8  Rules.  Rules prescribing procedures effectuating the purpose of this chapter shall be adopted by the department in consultation with the department of taxation pursuant to chapter 91. [L 1986, c 78, pt of §1; am L 1989, c 390, §3]
